🦺 NH HB303 — NH Could Match OSHA Safety Rules

New Hampshire employers could soon be required to follow safety standards similar to those set by the federal Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA).

This bill would task the Department of Labor with reviewing and adopting OSHA’s rules, updating them annually, and hiring up to six new labor inspectors to enforce these standards.

The state would also need to fund these inspectors and their operations, with costs covered by the Administration Fund or Restricted Fund.

This means New Hampshire businesses could face new requirements and inspections to ensure worker safety, aligning with national best practices.

Sept. 1, 2026: Full Committee Work Session: 10/13/2026 10:00 am GP 229.
